reviewed_head_message: paper(r5): transport verified manuscript and response capsule, part 2 of 10
scope: External harsh review to an Econometrica-level numerical-methods / quantitative-economics standard; not an editorial decision.
principal_findings: The main NDU certificate is for the finite candidate set A_h union the frozen neural proposal, not for the full continuous action/control problem.
The protocol explicitly excludes time, action-coverage, quadrature, interpolation, and continuous first-exit error from the finite certificate.
All three n=12 raw NDU runs fail the 0.05 target; safeguard success overwrites roughly 50-55 percent of interior state-date decisions.
Several sensitivity panels also require large safeguard corrections, with failing-run override fractions around 60-69 percent.
The recursive-utility raw actors miss the 0.01 target and are repaired by repeated 31x31 finite-action global_q sweeps.
The coupled NDU refinement still has no continuum error bound and shows economically material movement in value and exit probability.
The manufactured bridge/occupation certificate is one-dimensional, analytically manufactured, and non-neural; it does not certify the learned NDU calculation.
The 8/16/32-dimensional NBO benchmark has higher mean policy loss and longer training time than the in-house PINN-PI comparator at every reported dimension.
The high-dimensional actor is trained by regression to the analytic greedy target -2 grad v in a Cole-Hopf-solvable model, so it does not test the difficult implicit control optimization regime.
Extension seed counts and uncertainty reporting remain too thin for method-comparison claims.
The economic k-sensitivity remains coarse-action-grid and partly corner-driven.

The exact reviewed HEAD contains only manuscript transport parts 0 and 1 although the commit states part 2 of 10; canonical ECTA_R5.tex and SUPP_R5.tex are absent and the review-build workflow cannot reconstruct them.
